seo.title: Aluma Club
seo.description: Join the Aluma customer club — order tracking, saved pieces, early access to collections and members-only benefits.

title: Aluma Club
subtitle: A quiet world of service, cut to your measure.
perksSubtitle: Four benefits built around how Aluma customers actually work with us — from the moment you choose a piece to years after it's delivered.

tracking.title: Live project tracking
tracking.desc: See your order status, milestones and progress as they happen, without picking up the phone.

favorites.title: Saved pieces
favorites.desc: Mark collections, fabrics and configurations. Everything is kept and synced across your devices.

early.title: Early access
early.desc: New collections, exclusive finishes and invitations to private launches, before anyone else.

vip.title: Personal service
vip.desc: A designer who knows your project, a tidy record of every conversation, and priority on service requests.

joinTitle: Three minutes, no forms, no commitment
joinBody: You sign up once, and from then on the account simply remembers you, what you liked, and the project you started with us.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.desc: One minute — name, email and phone. No long forms.

verify.title: Quick verification
verify.desc: We verify the account and set up your personal profile.

open.title: Everything opens up
open.desc: Saved pieces, project tracking, benefits and private invitations.

terms.noSpam: No spam, and we never sell your details
